Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.runtime

Class EventMetadata

java.lang.Object
eu.cloudhopper.mc.runtime.EventMetadata
public final class EventMetadata extends Object
Describes the event that invoked a function with an EventTrigger.

Declare a parameter of this type to receive it. The field names follow CloudEvents. Values a platform does not provide are null (getTime()) or 0 (getDeliveryAttempt()).

  • Constructor Details

    • EventMetadata

      public EventMetadata(String id, String source, Instant time, int deliveryAttempt, Map<String,String> attributes)
      Creates the metadata of one event.
      Parameters:
      id - the id the platform assigned to the message
      source - the queue or topic the event came from
      time - when the message was sent, or null if unknown
      deliveryAttempt - how often the message has been delivered, starting at 1; 0 if unknown
      attributes - the message attributes; null for none
